_comment: Registry of the stack agents growth-sprint can chain. Paths in outputs, reads and inputs.from are relative to the founder's project folder (<your-projects-root>/<project>/); <YYYYMMDD> matches any 8-digit date and <label> the step label (any label when the step has none). spec and schema paths are relative to the repo root. spends: the agent has a step that can spend money (always behind its own gate). publishes: the agent can put something in front of an audience (always behind a human approval). human_gates are detected on disk or declared in the step result file, then surfaced in the sprint's needs_human queue; growth-sprint never clears them itself. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py agents/growth-sprint/assets/agents.schema.json agents/growth-sprint/assets/agents.json

project-context.purpose: Shared business and brand context every other agent reads (context.json, brand.json).

inputs.name: url
inputs.default: none: everything comes from the founder's answers

project-context.spend_note: Local brand extraction; a scrape or search API only if the founder configured one in tools.json.

market-signal.purpose: Verified customer language: pains, quotes with permalinks, objections, angles per format.
market-signal.spend_note: Free collectors by default; an API search provider only adds coverage and draws on the founder's own quota.

first-users-hunter.purpose: One row per person with a dated public signal, verified activity and a drafted first touch.
first-users-hunter.spend_note: Free collectors (HN, GitHub, Luma, official Reddit OAuth); nothing is sent, first touches are drafts.

seo-audit.purpose: Local crawl, Search Console bands, refresh briefs and GEO panel for one site.
seo-audit.spend_note: Paid SERP and answer-engine calls run only on an explicit yes inside the agent; without it free tiers take over and the run ends partial with the pending spend recorded.

human_gates.how: Answer the pending spend question of seo-audit (paid SERP or answer-engine calls) in a seo-audit session, then resolve the needs_human item.

landing-page-analyzer.purpose: Conversion audit of one page: driven journey, DOM probes, scored grid, fixes rendered before and after.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.default: the action of the page's primary CTA

landing-page-analyzer.spend_note: Local Playwright captures; PageSpeed Insights needs no key at low volume.

cold-outreach-builder.purpose: Sourced per-prospect dossiers, a sequence linted to zero BLOCK and a sequencer export.
cold-outreach-builder.spend_note: An email_finder API only if the founder configured one. Nothing is sent: the founder imports the export into their own sequencer.

carousel-builder.purpose: Sourced LinkedIn and Instagram carousel from a deck.json spec, rendered, measured and reviewed locally.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.default: best ranked direction of the cover board in autonomous mode

carousel-builder.spend_note: Renders locally for 0; an image model is a last resort through scripts/generate_image.py, and only with the founder's provider.

static-ads-builder.purpose: Funnel-aware static Meta ads rendered locally with exact copy, proofread, packaged for import (ads PAUSED).

inputs.name: performance_file
inputs.default: latest exports/*.csv or insights*.json in the agent folder

static-ads-builder.spend_note: Image plates only, behind Gate 1 (which plates) and Gate 2 (model, resolution, total) of the agent. The sprint approval never replaces either gate. Ads are imported PAUSED by the founder.

human_gates.how: Open a static-ads-builder session on this run: answer Gate 1 (which plates) and Gate 2 (model, resolution, total) yourself, or drop your own files with --provider manual. Then resolve the needs_human item.

content-publisher.purpose: One variant per network, a checked queue, scheduling of what a person approved only.
content-publisher.spend_note: Dry-run adapter by default; a real adapter needs --live and the founder's key.

human_gates.how: Read the review packet, then approve each item yourself in your own terminal: python3 agents/content-publisher/scripts/pubqueue.py approve <id> --queue <project>/content-publisher/queue.json --by <your-name> (or reject it). Then resolve the needs_human item; the sprint re-runs content-publisher to schedule what you approved.

founder-content-writer.purpose: LinkedIn and X posts in the founder's voice from their raw material, every passage and number checked, handed to content-publisher.

inputs.name: language
inputs.default: voice pack, then project-context voice.language, then the language of the raw material

inputs.name: posts_per_batch
inputs.default: 5, never padded past what the material holds

founder-content-writer.spend_note: Local scripts only. Nothing is queued, approved or published: content-publisher takes posts.json and a person approves there.

short-video-builder.purpose: Vertical 9:16 shorts from a landscape founder video, transcribed and rendered locally.
short-video-builder.spend_note: Local transcription and ffmpeg only. The founder approves and publishes the shorts (through content-publisher).

growth-pulse.purpose: Week-over-week numbers, correlations flagged as such, and 3 AARRR experiments for the next sprint.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.default: the analytics providers configured in growth-pulse/config.json

growth-pulse.spend_note: Reads the founder's analytics; an experiment that costs money carries spend_requires_approval and goes through the next sprint's approval.
